scripts.coverage:rust: rm -rf target/llvm-cov-target && cargo llvm-cov --package baresync-core --lib --text --output-dir /tmp/llvmcov-core && rm -rf target/llvm-cov-target && cargo llvm-cov --package tauri-plugin-baresync --lib --text --output-dir /tmp/llvmcov-tauri-plugin
